requirement: Running `habeas setup` in an existing Cargo and mdBook project MUST add Habeas as a dev dependency, configure `habeas mdbook` as its preprocessor, add the badge stylesheet, enable sidebar folding with `output.html.fold.enable` unless the book already sets it, and create `tests/habeas.rs` that calls `habeas::validate()`. Repeating setup MUST avoid duplicate configuration and MUST NOT overwrite a differing test or stylesheet. Setup MUST NOT install or modify agent skills.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Every obligation in `requirements.cli.setup` has code that carries it out, and each has a test that asserts the outcome.

`src/main.rs` (`fn[main]`, the `Command::Setup` arm) dispatches to `setup::run`. The tests drive `habeas setup` through the binary.

| Obligation | Code in `src/setup.rs` | Test in `tests/setup.rs` |
|---|---|---|
| Add Habeas as a dev dependency | `fn[run]` runs `cargo add --dev habeas`, with `--path` when a local crate is given. `fn[has_habeas_dev_dependency]` skips the add when the dependency already exists. | `setup_is_repeatable` checks `[dev-dependencies]`, `habeas` and `path =` in `Cargo.toml`. |
| Configure `habeas mdbook` as the preprocessor | `fn[run]` sets `preprocessor.habeas.command` and `renderers`. | `setup_is_repeatable` checks `command = "habeas mdbook"`. |
| Add the badge stylesheet | `fn[run]` registers it in `additional-css` once and writes it with `write_new_or_same`. | `setup_is_repeatable` checks that `md/habeas.css` is listed once and exists. `setup_uses_src_when_book_table_or_source_setting_is_absent` covers a `src/` book. |
| Enable fold with `output.html.fold.enable` unless already set | `fn[run]` inserts `enable = true` only when `fold` is absent or lacks `enable`. It handles table and inline-table forms and rejects a non-table `fold`. | `setup_is_repeatable` checks that `enable` is `true` and appears once. `setup_keeps_an_existing_fold_setting` covers `enable = false`, a `fold` with only `level`, and an inline table. `setup_rejects_invalid_book_configuration` covers `fold = true`. |
| Create `tests/habeas.rs` calling `habeas::validate()` | `fn[run]` writes `TEST_SOURCE` with `write_new_or_same`. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts the exact file content. |
| Repeating setup avoids duplicate configuration | `fn[run]` only pushes the CSS entry if it is missing and only inserts `enable` if it is missing. `fn[has_habeas_dev_dependency]` prevents a second `cargo add`. `fn[write_new_or_same]` skips identical files. | `setup_is_repeatable` runs setup twice and asserts one CSS entry and one `enable`. |
| MUST NOT overwrite a differing test or stylesheet | `fn[run]` checks both files before any write. `fn[write_new_or_same]` also refuses to overwrite. Both return an "already exists with different content" error. | `setup_does_not_overwrite_a_differing_test_or_stylesheet` covers both paths. It asserts failure, the error text, and that the file, `book.toml` and `Cargo.toml` are unchanged. |
| MUST NOT install or modify agent skills | `fn[run]` never touches skills. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts `.agents/skills` is absent. `setup_preserves_existing_agent_skills` asserts an existing skill is unchanged. |

**Unspecified behavior.** The extra work in `fn[run]` (nextest configuration and the coverage chapter) is specified by `requirements.test-coverage.setup`. `fn[coverage_chapter_plan]` carries an `{impl}` for that requirement, and its text begins "In addition to `requirements.cli.setup`". The book-source validation is specified by `requirements.cli.setup_project`, and the CSS handling by `requirements.cli.setup_css`. None of these is an unspecified behavior.
